text: ADD a dev-mode check that throws the error `QU22` when a query contains a value that JSON cannot represent, like `NaN`, `Infinity`, `-Infinity`, `bigint`, a function or a `Date`, in its `selector`, `sort`, `skip`, `limit` or `index`. RxDB queries are JSON, so such values are not supported. Before, they were silently written as `null` or dropped, so that for example `{$gt: -Infinity}` and `{$gt: Infinity}` shared one cached `RxQuery`
